lessons.title: Micro-Lesson 1A: Exponent Product & Power Rules
lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Exponent Properties (Product & Power Rules)
lessons.reading: One rule at a time! Product Rule: when multiplying powers with the same base, keep the base and ADD the exponents (x^a · x^b = x^(a+b)). Power Rule: when raising a power to another power, MULTIPLY the exponents ((x^a)^b = x^(a·b)).

principles.title: Multiplying Powers with the Same Base
principles.summary: Add the exponents when multiplying powers with the same base: x^a · x^b = x^(a+b).

principles.title: Power of a Power Rule
principles.summary: Multiply the exponents when raising a power to a power: (x^a)^b = x^(a·b).

lessons.title: Micro-Lesson 1B: Scientific Notation for Large Numbers
lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Intro to Scientific Notation
lessons.reading: Scientific notation writes very large numbers in the compact form a × 10^n, where 1 ≤ a < 10. Count how many places you move the decimal point to the left so only one non-zero digit remains in front; that count is the exponent n.

principles.title: Writing Large Numbers in Scientific Notation
principles.summary: Place the decimal after the first non-zero digit and count places moved as the power of 10.

lessons.title: Micro-Lesson 1C: Evaluating Square Roots
lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Square Roots of Perfect Squares
lessons.reading: Finding a square root is the inverse of squaring a number. The principal square root √n asks: "What positive number multiplied by itself equals n?" For example, √49 = 7 because 7 × 7 = 49.

principles.title: Evaluating Square Roots of Perfect Squares
principles.summary: Find the positive factor that, when multiplied by itself, equals the radicand.

lessons.title: Micro-Lesson 2A: Finding Slope & Slope-Intercept Form (y = mx + b)
lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Slope Formula & Slope-Intercept Intro
lessons.reading: Slope (m) measures steepness: m = (y₂ - y₁) ÷ (x₂ - x₁) ("rise over run"). In slope-intercept form y = mx + b, m is the rate of change (slope) and b is the y-intercept (where the line crosses the vertical y-axis at x = 0).

principles.title: Finding Slope from Two Coordinate Points
principles.summary: Compute m = (y₂ - y₁) ÷ (x₂ - x₁) to find the rate of change between two points.

principles.title: Identifying Slope & Y-Intercept in y = mx + b
principles.summary: In y = mx + b, m is the coefficient of x (slope) and b is the constant term (y-intercept).

lessons.title: Micro-Lesson 2B: Multi-Step Equations, Systems & Function Rules
lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Equations with Variables on Both Sides & Systems
lessons.reading: To solve ax + b = cx + d, subtract cx from both sides to gather x terms on the left, subtract b to gather constants on the right, then divide. For a system of equations, substitute the known value of x to find y. For a function f(x) = mx + b, plug in the input x and simplify.

principles.title: Solving Equations with Variables on Both Sides
principles.summary: Collect variable terms on one side and constants on the other, then divide.

principles.title: Solving Systems of Linear Equations by Substitution
principles.summary: Substitute the known coordinate into the second equation to find the intersection point (x, y).

principles.title: Evaluating Linear Function Rules f(x) = mx + b
principles.summary: Substitute the input value x into f(x) = mx + b to compute the output.

units.title: Unit 3: Pythagorean Theorem, Transformations & Cylinder Volume

lessons.title: Micro-Lesson 3A: Pythagorean Theorem (Hypotenuse & Missing Leg)
lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Intro to the Pythagorean Theorem
lessons.reading: In any right triangle with legs a and b and hypotenuse c (the longest side across from the right angle), a² + b² = c². To find the hypotenuse, compute c = √(a² + b²). To find a missing leg, subtract: b = √(c² - a²).

principles.title: Finding the Hypotenuse with a² + b² = c²
principles.summary: Square both legs, add them together, and take the square root to find hypotenuse c.

principles.title: Finding a Missing Leg with b² = c² - a²
principles.summary: Subtract the known leg squared from the hypotenuse squared, then take the square root.

assignment.scopeSummary: [Pythagorean Theorem & Geometry] Micro-Lesson Scope (~10 min total): Complete ONLY the 3 bite-sized steps below for "Finding the Hypotenuse with a² + b² = c² & Finding a Missing Leg with b² = c² - a²" (8.G.B.7, 8.G.B.7), then return to this tab for your randomized Mastery Check.

lessons.title: Micro-Lesson 3B: Coordinate Translations & Volume of Cylinders
lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Translations & Cylinder Volume (V = πr²h)
lessons.reading: To translate a point (x, y) on the coordinate plane, add to x when moving right (subtract when moving left) and add to y when moving up (subtract when moving down). For a cylinder with radius r and height h (Ohio Standard OH.8.G.C.9), multiply circular base area πr² by height h: V = πr²h.

principles.title: Coordinate Plane Translations
principles.summary: Shift (x, y) horizontally by adding/subtracting dx and vertically by adding/subtracting dy.

principles.title: Volume of Cylinders (V = πr²h)
principles.summary: Square the radius r, multiply by height h, and attach π cubic units.
